body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''YP-K5'' mp3 player equipped with a built-in stereo speaker. It was showcased during IFA 2006 in Berlin, Germany for the first time.
